zh.text: 「部署服务端」的检查与安装详情、进度消息补齐 8 种语言：服务端脚本输出的英文消息会自动翻译成当前界面语言。
市场快照下载现在显示约 20 MB 的总量与每 3 秒更新的实时进度；超过 1 分钟没有变化时提示网络可能被卡住。
修复未准备的客户端副本无法安装证书：现在会先按服务端 GUI 的顺序应用 start.ini 本地设置（server = 127.0.0.1 / cryptoPack = Placebo，自动备份 start.ini.original），再安装客户端证书。
环境自检的 Node.js 要求与服务端安装器对齐为 Node.js 26 LTS ≥26.13.1（原先只判 ≥22）。

en.text: The Deploy Server check/install details and progress messages are now localized in all 8 languages; the English messages emitted by the server scripts are translated automatically.
Market snapshot downloads now show the ~20 MB size and live progress, polled every 3 seconds, with a warning when nothing changes for over a minute.

Fixed certificate installation on unprepared client copies: the launcher now applies the start.ini settings first (server = 127.0.0.1 / cryptoPack = Placebo, backing up start.ini.original), matching the server GUI order, then installs the client certificate.
The environment check now requires Node.js 26 LTS ≥26.13.1, matching the server installer (previously it only checked ≥22).
